name: DOB NOW: Safety - Parking Structure Compliance Filings
description: This dataset contains records from New York City's DOB NOW: Safety system for parking structure compliance filings. Each row represents a parking structure filing and includes identifiers such as parking structure ID, BIN, block, lot, and address details (house number, street name, borough, ZIP), along with building classification and owner name. It also captures filing characteristics like filing name, status, and type, plus parking capacity information including total vehicle parking spaces, spaces with EV charging, and EV-ready spaces. Additional fields cover compliance and inspection tracking, such as unsafe SREM completion dates, compliance report creation, PIPS cycle and sub-cycle, current cycle last inspection, and report status. Geographic fields include latitude, longitude, council district, census tract, neighborhood tabulation area, and BBL. The data could be used to monitor parking structure compliance and inspection status across the city, analyze EV charging infrastructure availability in parking facilities, identify structures with overdue or completed compliance actions, and support planning or research by linking
